title: Repair / Replacement of Mission and Industrial HVAC and Refrigeration Systems
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE ARMY > AMC > ACC > ACC-CTRS > ACC-NJ > W6QK ACC-PICA
description: The U.S. Army Contracting Command - Rock Island at Picatinny (ACC-RI-PI), on behalf of the U.S. Army Combat Capabilities and Development Command (DEVCOM) Armaments Center (AC), at Picatinny Arsenal, NJ intends to competitively select and award multiple firm-fixed-price (FFP) Blanket Purchase Agreements (BPAs) for Repair / Replacement of Mission and Industrial HVAC and Refrigeration Systems in accordance with the following solicitation requirements, the attached Performance Work Statement (PWS), Quality Assurance Surveillance Plan (QASP)/Performance Requirements Summary (PRS) and Contract Data Requirements List (CDRLs) / DD Form 1423.
